Hi Siobhán,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — team really liked the integration possibilities. Procurement here is starting the vendor intake so we can get a PO in place for the pilot. To move quickly, can you please provide the following items by EOD Mon (15 Jun):

- Signed vendor supplier form (attached is our template)
- Tax documentation: W-9 (if US entity) or W-8BEN-E, plus VAT registration if applicable
- Legal entity name and address to appear on the PO
- Billing contact and remittance email + invoice cadence (e.g., monthly)
- Bank details for ACH / international wire (or attach a vendor banking form)

I attached a pre-filled Supplier Form with the info we captured. If VectorGrid is non-US, W-8BEN-E is fine; if you invoice from a US subsidiary, we will need a W-9. Also flag any data residency or contractual clauses that might impact payment terms.

Next steps from our side: once we have the completed pack, Finance (Marissa) will validate tax docs and create the PO. Please cc procurement@vectorgrid.ie on your reply.

Thanks — appreciate a quick turnaround so the pilot can start next week.

Best,
